profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
Formation of Puttaparthi Assembly Constituency
The major part of the present Puttaparthi Assembly Constituency is formerly a part of Nallamada Assembly Constituency (Nallamada, Mohammadabad and Tanakal firkas in Kadiri, taluk) until 2009.  The Delimitation Commission setup in 2002, modified the picture of Assembly Constituencies in the State based on as per  Census 2001. In 2008, the Delimitation Commission in its report discontinued the Nallamada Assembly Constituency and carved out a new Assembly Constituency in the name of Puttaparthi, the abode Bhagavan Sri Sathya Sai Baba. Later the Government of Andhra Pradesh in 2022 restructured the districts and created new districts and revenue divisions. The Puttaparthi Revenue Division was carved out of erstwhile Kadiri and Penukonda divisions in April 2022 by G.O.Ms.No.176, Revenue (Lands-IV), 2nd April, 2022. The new Revenue Division consists of 6 Revenue Mandals and 1 Municipality. With the formation of new Revenue Division, the Puttaparthi Assembly Constituency is divided into 2 Revenue Divisions namely Puttaparthi and Kadiri. The major part of the Puttaparthi Assembly Constituency lies in Puttaparthi Revenue Division. The 5 Mandals namely Puttaparthi, Nallamada, Obuladevaracheruvu, Bukkpatnam and Kothacheruvu are located in this divisions and one revenue Mandal namely Amadagur is located in Kadiri revenue Division.
profile.geography: The Constituency is bordered by Dharmavaram Constituency towards north and north-west Rapthadu Constituency towards West and South-west, Penukonda Constituency and towards East Kadiri Constituency and Karnataka to the south. Proximity to Hyderabad (430KM), Bengaluru (160KM) and Chennai (350Km) is an advantage. The Puttaparthi Constituency geography is characterized by fertile Red soils and a network of Chitravathi River and Bukkapatanam Chikkavadayar cheruvu of Bukkapatanam Mandal.
profile.populationDesc: As per census 2011 the total population of the ac is 2.574 lakhs among them 1.299 lakhs were male and 1.275 lakhs were females.The sex ratio of the ac is 981. The total literacy rate of the AC is 60.54%
profile.administrationDesc: Puttaparthi Constituency is one of the six assembly constituencies in Sri Satya Sai District. It includes 1) Puttaparthi,2) Nallamada,3) Obuladevara cheruvu,4) Bukkpatnam,5) Kothacheruvu,6) Amadagur Mandals and also it has Puttaparthi  municipality.
profile.educationHealthcareDesc: In Puttaparthi Constituency, there are two Community Health Centers in Nallamada and Kothacheruvumandal headquarters, besides these there are 9 Primary Health Centers. At the rate 1 per each Mandal there are six 108 and 104 medical emergency services in the AC. The Puttaparthi Assembly Constituency has a strong foundation in school education with 255 Primary Schools, 26 Upper Primary Schools, and 56 High Schools. It also includes 1 Special School catering to children with special needs. For intermediate-level education, there are 13 Junior Colleges.In terms of higher education, the constituency hosts 4 Degree Colleges and 1 Engineering College, along with 1 Agricultural Engineering College, contributing to technical and professional education. Additionally, the presence of 2 ITIs (Industrial Training Institutes) supports skill development. The region also has 1 University, offering higher education and research opportunities.
profile.culturalheritageDesc: Puttaparthi has famous pilgrimage sites like Bhagavan Sri Sathya Sai Baba Mandiram,  Shivalayam, Samadhi (Sepulcher) of Sri Sathya Sai’s Parents, Lord Dattatreya Temple, Gopalaswamy Temple,  Vata Vriksha or meditation Tree, Kalpatharu, the wish-filling Tree, Sai geetha Samadhi, Chennakesava Swamy temple.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Puttaparthi projects robust growth, with Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) rising from ₹5,268 crores in 2024-25 to ₹10,710 crores by 2028-29, driven by an average annual growth rate of 15%. 

This trajectory reflects a shift toward balanced sectoral contributions, with agriculture maintaining dominance (50% of GVA) while services and industry expand through diversification and infrastructure investments

Growth Drivers: Religious Tourism, Infrastructure, and Agriculture

Major Clusters: Bhagavan Sri Sathya Sai Baba Mandiram and Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Limited (APIIC)
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Puttaparthi is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like real estate, MSME-led industrialization and organic farming. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant rural and economic hub by 2047
